```{r setup}
here::i_am("orben2019-ablation-3-MCS.qmd")
source(here::here("R", "_load.R"))
```

This document contains the ablation study for the MCS Total multiverse dataset
from Orben & Przybylski (2019, *Nature Human Behaviour*). Every decision is
fixed to one option in turn, importance estimates are recomputed on the reduced
multiverse, and the resulting importance vectors are compared across methods
and across options of the fixed decision.

```{r mcs-load-data}
mv_mcs <- load_multiverse("orben2019nhb_mcs_total")
```

## Ablation Study

`mv_dim_y_variable` is one-hot encoded (via `expand_y_variable()`) for the
regression and FANOVA methods: regression needs a numeric design matrix, and
FANOVA's random forest cannot handle the raw categorical (~1,700 unique levels
here, which overflows the forest's categorical split representation). DECIDE
uses it as-is. The expanded per-variable importances are collapsed back to a
single `mv_dim_y_variable` entry.

Similar to MTF, fanova total importance is not computed for practical reasons.

```{r mcs-ablation-run}
ablation_mcs <- run_ablation_analysis(
  mv_mcs,
  colname_metric = "effect",
  regression_mv_pre_process = expand_y_variable,
  regression_post_process = aggregate_onehot_importances,
  fanova_mv_pre_process = expand_y_variable,
  fanova_post_process = aggregate_onehot_importances,
  include_fanova_total = FALSE,
  cor_method = "pearson"
)
```

### Inter-method stability

```{r mcs-ablation-inter-method-table}
ablation_mcs$inter_method_stability_summary |>
  mutate(
    fixed_decision_label = if_else(
      fixed_decision == "full_multiverse",
      "full multiverse",
      fixed_decision_label
    )
  ) |>
  select(
    fixed_decision_label,
    method_x,
    method_y,
    mean_rank_correlation,
    min_rank_correlation
  )
```

```{r mcs-ablation-inter-method-plot}
#| fig-width: 3.2
#| fig-height: 4
# same row order in the inter- and intra-method heatmaps
decision_order_mcs <- stability_decision_order(ablation_mcs$intra_method_stability_summary)
p <- vis_inter_method_stability(
  ablation_mcs$inter_method_stability_summary,
  fill_label = "Mean Pearson\ncorrelation",
  fill_option = "plasma",
  decision_order = decision_order_mcs,
  value_size = 1.6
) + theme_stability_compact(left_margin = 22)
p
ggsave(here("figures", "mcs-ablation-inter-method.pdf"), p, width = 3.2, height = 4, create.dir = TRUE)
```

### Intra-method stability

```{r mcs-ablation-intra-method-table}
ablation_mcs$intra_method_stability_summary |>
  select(
    fixed_decision_label,
    method,
    mean_rank_correlation,
    min_rank_correlation,
    mean_abs_difference
  )
```

```{r mcs-ablation-intra-method-plot}
#| fig-width: 3.2
#| fig-height: 4
p <- vis_intra_method_stability(
  ablation_mcs$intra_method_stability_summary,
  fill_label = "Mean Pearson\ncorrelation",
  fill_option = "cividis",
  decision_order = decision_order_mcs,
  value_size = 1.6
) + theme_stability_compact()
p
ggsave(here("figures", "mcs-ablation-intra-method.pdf"), p, width = 3.2, height = 4, create.dir = TRUE)
```
